Pull a study's cohort from a master view

Source: R/master_pull.R
pull_master.Rd

Selects a cohort and reads its rows from a master view in one transaction under snapshot isolation, so the cohort, its data, the corrections applied to it and the deployment it came from describe one state of the warehouse even while decisions, loads or deployments commit.

Usage

pull_master(
  con,
  master,
  cohort,
  var_cols,
  path,
  mrn_col = "mrn",
  date_col = "encounter_date",
  dialect = c("mssql", "duckdb"),
  applied_view = paste0(master, "_corrections_applied"),
  deployment_view = paste0(master, "_deployment"),
  parity_view = paste0(master, "_parity"),
  columns,
  study_config
)

Arguments

con

A DBI::DBIConnection to the warehouse, or to duckdb in tests.

master

Character. The master view, optionally schema-qualified ("dbo.master_cardiac").

cohort

A cohort_query(), or a new_cohort_record() built on cohort_unit_id() units (patient_id_col = "cohort_unit").

var_cols

Character. The study's columns, besides the key.

path

Character. Path to the study configuration file that defines this pull. Its checksum is recorded in the provenance.

mrn_col, date_col

Character. The master's key columns.

dialect

"mssql" (the warehouse) or "duckdb" (tests).

applied_view, deployment_view, parity_view

Character. The master's applied-corrections, deployment and parity-verdict views.

columns

Deprecated; use var_cols.

study_config

Deprecated; use path.

Value

An object of class master_pull: a list with data (one row per active unit: the key columns, var_cols and cohort_unit), cohort (the cohort record, ending with the in_master stage) and meta: the family's provenance record (package, version, sha, method, seed, rng_kind, time), then master, sql_commit, applied_correction_ids, corrections_in_effect, parity_verified_at, read_at, columns, cohort_definition, study_config_sha256, n_cohort, n_matched and n_unmatched. The same pull fields without the provenance record are also in provenance, which is deprecated and goes in the next release; read meta. corrections_in_effect holds every correction id applied anywhere in the master in the same snapshot, including any that changed who qualified.

Details

The cohort's keys go into a session temp table, which is joined to the master inside the database. For a cohort_query() the epoch, the index and the earlier- encounter flag are computed in SQL, so no key outside the cohort leaves the database. For a supplied new_cohort_record() of cohort_unit_id() units, its active units are loaded. The temp table is dropped before commit and never outlives the connection, so no patient list persists in the warehouse.

The master must have passed its parity gate at the deployed SQL commit: the most recent verdict in parity_view for that commit must be "pass". Otherwise nothing is pulled. The gate is read in the same snapshot as the data.

The study configuration's SHA-256 is recorded when the pull runs, so freeze_study_pull() can refuse a configuration that changed afterwards.

The returned cohort ends with an in_master stage that excludes units with no master row, so the data match the active cohort exactly. A unit matching more than one master row stops the pull, because the key is meant to be unique. Nothing in an error or in printed output names a patient.

See also

cohort_query(), build_from_master(), freeze_study_pull()

Examples

# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("duckdb", quietly = TRUE)) {
  # Synthetic data; no PHI.
  con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb())
  DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "master_demo", data.frame(
    mrn = c("SYN101", "SYN102"),
    encounter_date = as.Date(c("2010-03-01", "2012-07-15")),
    proc = c("CABG", "AVR"), age = c(62, 70)
  ))
  DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "master_demo_corrections_applied", data.frame(
    correction_id = character(), mrn = character(), encounter_date = as.Date(character())
  ))
  DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "master_demo_deployment", data.frame(sql_commit = "abc1234"))
  DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "master_demo_parity", data.frame(
    sql_commit = "abc1234", verdict = "pass", verified_at = Sys.time()
  ))
  config <- tempfile(fileext = ".yaml")
  writeLines("study: st0000", config)
  q <- cohort_query("proc = 'CABG'", as.Date(c("2000-01-01", "2024-07-31")))
  pull_master(con, "master_demo", q, var_cols = "age", path = config,
              dialect = "duckdb")
  DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
}
